# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost
invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a
special bonus between +25 and +75 to Stalking/Hiding maneuvers).
@@ 2
Up to three objects (e.g., 1 garment, 1 naked body, and 1 weapon) are made
invisible. The object(s) will remain invisible until 24 hours pass, or the
object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.), or
the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).
@@ 3
Target inanimate object takes on the visual appearance of a similar object.
For example, a small red key may appear as a small blue spoon. The object
cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given
dimension. This is strictly a visual illusion (and can be detected as such),
see Section 15.14 (p. 98).
@@ 4
Allows the caster to find any inanimate object. The caster must be able to
uniquely describe the object.
@@ 5
Creates an area of darkness up to 2' radius per level about the point touched.
The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile object
or being, it will move with the object or being. See Section 15.12 (p. 98).
@@ 6
Target inanimate object takes on the visual and tactile appearance of another
object. For example, a crystal goblet might look and feel like a wooden mug.
The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any
given dimension. This is an illusion (and can be detected as such), see
Section 15.14 (p. 98).
@@ 7
As Unseen III, except affects up to five objects.
@@ 8
Target appears to be offset from where he actually is. All attacks have no
effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses him, the chance of that foe
missing again drops by 5%.
@@ 9
As Conceal I, except affects up to three objects.
@@ 10
As Unseen III, except affects up to ten objects.
@@ 11
As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.
@@ 12
As Secret I, except affects up to three objects.
@@ 13
As Unseen III, except affects up to fifteen objects.
@@ 15
As Conceal I, except affects up to five objects.
@@ 16
As Unseen III, except affects up to twenty objects.
@@ 17
As Secret I, except affects up to five objects.
@@ 18
As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.
@@ 20
As Conceal I, except affects up to ten objects.
@@ 25
As Unseen III, except affects up to one object for every level of the caster.
@@ 30
As Secret I, except affects up to ten objects.
@@ 50
As Conceal I, except affects a number of objects equal to the caster’s level.
